# Marshall

Marshalls are responsible for 'herding' swimmers on poolside during an event to
ensure each swimmer is where they need to be to make sure the gala runs to 
schedule.
It can be hectic, loud and fast-paced poolside, so Marshalls play a key role
in bringing some order to the chaos!
No prior experience or swimming knowledge is needed to be a gala marshall.
You must, however have a basic DBS check and undertake an online child 
safeguarding course.
You can sign up to marshall at one of our events by responding to the link you
will be sent via email when a gala is set up on Swim Manager.

To find out more about becoming a Marshall, speak to the club's [Workforce Coordinator](tomsmum@icloud.com)
or the [Club Secretary](mailto:secretary@alnwickdolphins.co.uk).
